title: Turkish Stuffed Pilaf
description: A flavorful and nutritious dish made with pilaf, beans, and a hint of Turkish spices. It's perfect for a satisfying meal.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the Nourishing Oil over medium heat.
Add the Turkish Spice Blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pilaf and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly toasted.
In a separate bowl, mix together the beans, Salt, and Black Pepper.
Spoon the pilaf mixture into the center of the Flaky Pastry, leaving a 1-inch border.
Top with the bean mixture and fold the pastry over to form a triangle.
Brush the edges with a little Nourishing Oil and bake for 25-30 minutes.
Garnish with chopped Fresh Parsley and serve warm.
